verses.translation: Praise of a Song, by David. He that dwells in the help of the Highest, shall sojourn under the shelter of the God of heaven.

translations.ron: Cel ce locuieşte în ajutorul Celui Preaînalt, întru acoperământul Dumnezeului cerului se va sălăşlui.
translations.grk: Αἶνος ᾠδῆς τῷ Δαυίδ. Ὁ κατοικῶν ἐν βοηθείᾳ τοῦ ὑψίστου, ἐν σκέπῃ τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ αὐλισθήσεται.

verses.translation: He shall say to the Lord, Thou art my helper and my refuge: my God; I will hope in him.

translations.ron: Va zice Domnului: "Sprijinitorul meu eşti şi scăparea mea; Dumnezeul meu, voi nădăjdui spre Dânsul".
translations.grk: Ἐρεῖ τῷ Κυρίῳ, ἀντιλήπτωρ μου εἶ καὶ καταφυγή μου, ὁ Θεός μου, ἐλπιῶ ἐπʼ αὐτόν.

verses.translation: For he shall deliver thee from the snare of the hunters, from every troublesome matter.

translations.ron: Că El te va izbăvi din cursa vânătorilor şi de cuvântul tulburător.
translations.grk: Ὅτι αὐτὸς ῥύσεταί σε ἐκ παγίδος θηρευτῶν, ἀπὸ λόγου ταραχώδους.

verses.translation: He shall overshadow thee with his shoulders, and thou shalt trust under his wings: his truth shall cover thee with a shield.

translations.ron: Cu spatele te va umbri pe tine şi sub aripile Lui vei nădăjdui; ca o armă te va înconjura adevărul Lui.
translations.grk: Ἐν τοῖς μεταφρένοις αὐτοῦ ἐπισκιάσει σοι, καὶ ὑπὸ τὰς πτέρυγας αὐτοῦ ἐλπιεῖς· ὅπλῳ κυκλώσει σε ἡ ἀλήθεια αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: Thou shalt not be afraid of terror by night; nor of the arrow flying by day;

translations.ron: Nu te vei teme de frica de noapte, de săgeata ce zboară ziua,
translations.grk: Οὐ φοβηθήσῃ ἀπὸ φόβου νυκτερινοῦ, ἀπὸ βέλους πετομένου ἡμέρας,

verses.translation: nor of the evil thing that walks in darkness; nor of calamity, and the evil spirit at noon-day.

translations.ron: De lucrul ce umblă în întuneric, de molima ce bântuie întru amiază.
translations.grk: ἀπὸ πράγματος διαπορευομένου ἐν σκότει, ἀπὸ συμπτώματος καὶ δαιμονίου μεσημβρινοῦ.

verses.translation: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.

translations.ron: Cădea-vor dinspre latura ta o mie şi zece mii de-a dreapta ta, dar de tine nu se vor apropia.
translations.grk: Πεσεῖται ἐκ τοῦ κλίτους σου χιλιὰς, καὶ μυριὰς ἐκ δεξιῶν σου, πρὸς σὲ δὲ οὐκ ἐγγιεῖ.

verses.translation: Only with thine eyes shalt thou observe and see the reward of sinners.

translations.ron: Însă cu ochii tăi vei privi şi răsplătirea păcătoşilor vei vedea.
translations.grk: Πλὴν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς σου κατανοήσεις, καὶ ἀνταπόδοσιν ἁμαρτωλῶν ὄψει.

verses.translation: For thou, O Lord, art my hope: thou, my soul, hast made the Most High thy refuge.

translations.ron: Pentru că pe Domnul, nădejdea mea, pe Cel Preaînalt L-ai pus scăpare ţie.
translations.grk: Ὅτι σὺ Κύριε ἡ ἐλπίς μου, τὸν ὕψιστον ἔθου καταφυγήν σου.

verses.translation: No evils shall come upon thee, and no scourge shall draw nigh to thy dwelling.

translations.ron: Nu vor veni către tine rele şi bătaie nu se va apropia de locaşul tău.
translations.grk: Οὐ προσελεύσεται πρὸς σὲ κακὰ, καὶ μάστιξ οὐκ ἐγγιεῖ τῷ σκηνώματί σου.

verses.translation: For he shall give his angels charge concerning thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

translations.ron: Că îngerilor Săi va porunci pentru tine ca să te păzească în toate căile tale.
translations.grk: Ὅτι τοῖς ἀγγέλοις αὐτοῦ ἐντελεῖται περὶ σοῦ, τοῦ διαφυλάξαι σε ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ὁδοῖς σου.

verses.translation: They shall bear thee up on their hands, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

translations.ron: Pe mâini te vor înălţa ca nu cumva să împiedici de piatră piciorul tău.
translations.grk: Ἐπὶ χειρῶν ἀροῦσί σε, μή ποτε προσκόψῃς πρὸς λίθον τὸν πόδα σου.

verses.translation: Thou shalt tread on the asp and basilisk: and thou shalt trample on the lion and dragon.

translations.ron: Peste aspidă şi vasilisc vei păşi şi vei călca peste leu şi peste balaur.
translations.grk: Ἐπʼ ἀσπίδα καὶ βασιλίσκον ἐπιβήσῃ, καὶ καταπατήσεις λέοντα καὶ δράκοντα.

verses.translation: For he has hoped in me, and I will deliver him: I will protect him, because he has known my name.

translations.ron: "Că spre Mine a nădăjduit şi-l voi izbăvi pe el, zice Domnul; îl voi acoperi pe el că a cunoscut numele Meu.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐπʼ ἐμὲ ἤλπισε, καὶ ῥύσομαι αὐτόν· σκεπάσω αὐτὸν, ὅτι ἔγνω τὸ ὄνομά μου.

verses.translation: He shall call upon me, and I will hearken to him: I am with him in affliction; and I will deliver him, and glorify him.

translations.ron: Striga-va către Mine şi-l voi auzi pe el; cu dânsul sunt în necaz şi-l voi scoate pe el şi-l voi slăvi.
translations.grk: Ἐπικαλέσεται πρὸς μὲ, καὶ εἰσακούσομαι αὐτοῦ, μετʼ αὐτοῦ εἰμι ἐν θλίψει, καὶ ἐξελοῦμαι αὐτὸν, καὶ δοξάσω αὐτόν.

verses.translation: I will satisfy him with length of days, and shew him my salvation.

translations.ron: Cu lungime de zile îl voi umple pe el, şi-i voi arăta lui mântuirea Mea".
translations.grk: Μακρότητι ἡμερῶν ἐμπλήσω αὐτὸν, καὶ δείξω αὐτῷ τὸ σωτήριόν μου.
